scope: All fourteen Mechs and culturebotai-claw were pinned from one GitHub head query for the November 9, 2026 refresh. The common pin-time bound is 2026-11-09T12:41:41.170118+00:00. Census occurrences, shared-term overlap assets, complete heatmap record lists, recent-record histories and repository statistics use those same immutable revisions. Record globs, namespace recognition and normalization, shared-term extraction and the separately pinned kg-microbe release comparison are unchanged. Card figures and secondary claims were rechecked against pinned source files and live sites; repository and published-browser totals retain their stated distinctions. Merged-PR counts are all-time totals queried during this refresh for fourteen Mechs, CLAW and this website. Website feature verdicts have their own dates, served revisions and browser-review scope in site_features.json. The separately versioned kg-microbe core release comparison remains excluded from Mech record totals and shared-term graph indexes.

notes.AntibioticMech: 3,125 data/antibiotics records at the pin, equal to the published stat tile: 2,782 ontology-grounded and 343 minted. The README and corpus contain 159 REVIEWED, 167 PROPOSED and 2,799 SEEDED records, 557 with a mode of action and 374 with a molecular target.
notes.CellStructureMech: 1,022 data/structures records at the pin, equal to the stat tile: 13 categories, 873 GO-grounded, 149 minted and 226 membrane organelles. All 1,022 are PROPOSED. The generated README and corpus contain 848 records with components and 991 with causal graphs (1,023 individual graphs and 4,704 evidence-backed edges); 74 records have imaging data.
notes.CommunityMech: The published landing tile counts 511 kb/communities records. Eighteen additional data/isolates records make the common census and repository-statistics total 529. The landing category tile agrees with the schema enum and browser facet: 16 categories, including PHAGE_PREDATION. Embedding maps are separate derived artifacts and currently show 322 PaCMAP and 292 graph-layout communities.
notes.CultureMech: The committed README and app/index.html both state 15,915 normalized and 6,325 merged records, matching the corpus directories at the pin. The card checker retains the README corpus snapshot as its count source. docs/DATA_LAYERS.md documents GitHub Actions publishing for the generated browser assets and checks both README and landing-page counts against the corpus. Five category directories are populated. MediaIngredientMech links occur in 5,705 merged recipes and 70,480 of 100,480 ingredient rows (70.1%). Browser evidence and CommunityMech provenance links have improved without changing these corpus totals.
notes.HabitatMech: 3,209 data/habitats records at the pin, equal to the stat tiles: 1,298 REVIEWED, 1,911 SEEDED and 2,147 ontology-grounded by the site’s grounding-status measure. REVIEWED is a recorded status, not proof of human review. The README and corpus contain 175 records attested by at least two distinct sources.
notes.MediaIngredientMech: The pinned records and checked data/ingredients.json index contain 2,956 ingredients: 2,611 MAPPED, 262 UNMAPPED, 82 REJECTED and 1 AMBIGUOUS (88% mapped after rounding). Ingredient evidence and specific CultureMech recipe links are now rendered in the browser. Browser metadata uses directory placement instead of status for the separate mapped/unmapped file totals. The new causal-graph schema admits sibling-record links, but no ingredient record contains a causal graph at this pin; the associated snapshots and semantic integration remain planned.
notes.NaturalProductMech: 3,136 natural product structures at the pin, matching the landing prose, with ten adopted sources including PathwayMech. The README and page report 3,441 producer claims, 840 supported by evidence addressing the organism, and 2,351 records with cited occurrences. The corpus has 216 records describing biosynthetic pathways. Resolving the pinned causal_graph_refs gives 317 graph-bearing records and 815 individual graphs: 569 inline graphs plus 246 referenced components. Every referenced component matches its owner’s record ID and InChIKey. The vocabulary census retains its existing owner-record globs and does not separately scan these component files.
notes.ProteinTraitsMech: 429,421 records and 34 browser source labels in runtime data/facets.json and the YAML corpus (the static landing HTML states 429,291). The source-label fallback manual groups several imported sources; it is not a distinct evidence source. The retained corpus map covers 344,797 current records, with 84,624 outside that snapshot. The protein map covers 68,657 Swiss-Prot proteins and the sequence map covers 12,705; these derived views are distinct from the complete record browser. The committed cross-Mech snapshot scans thirteen sibling repositories and retains 16,082 recognized UniProt mentions from six of them, including structured fields and prose references. These discovery records are separate from the measured data/traits corpus. Its protein inventory distinguishes 958 proteins with qualified examples, 648 with legacy examples only and 996 discovery-only proteins; those qualifications are not whole-record REVIEWED statuses, and sibling assertions alone do not qualify examples.
notes.TaxonMech: 626,048 species-level and infraspecific data/taxa records at the pin, equal to the landing tile. The site lists 100,745 distinct strains, 20,648 taxa with a type strain and 21,071 listed strains with genome identifiers. Higher taxa are carried in lineage fields rather than counted as standalone records. The canonical taxon tree and README statistics are unchanged; browser rendering and filters have advanced.
notes.TraitMech: 1,130 data/traits records at the pin: 427 REVIEWED, 615 PROPOSED, 50 DEPRECATED and 38 SEEDED. The README and corpus contain 769 records with causal graphs. The pinned page shows 10 populated categories and 100.0% embedded (1,130 of 1,130).
notes.PathwayMech: 282 data/pathways records at the pin, matching 282 links in its committed browser. They contain 14,838 mechanistic edges across 105 taxa, with 5,922 distinct reference IDs. The corpus contains 22,178 structured source assertions and 884 quoted evidence items. Current complete KGX downloads under pages/downloads match all 282 records; separate SSSOM source mappings remain available in the repository. Export availability does not establish kg-microbe ingestion. The optional curation_history schema retains its explicit TaxonMech CurationEvent reference; 106 YAML records contain 129 inline events, with additional canonical history stored separately. PathwayMech is measured by the common census, subset and statistics pipeline.
notes.DUFMech: 8,296 seed families in data/worklists/interpro-pfam-duf-2026-10-10.json, validated against its frozen manifest: 6,127 UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE, 373 KNOWN_HISTORICAL_DUF and 1,796 EX_DUF. EX_DUF records Pfam naming history, not validated function. Each JSON row is one measured family; the TSV is a redundant serialization. Counts, heatmap occurrences and shared-term links measure this seed worklist. Native FamilyRecords have a LinkML schema and public family pages with evidence, curation history and specific cross-Mech leads; 8,154 are SEEDED and 142 are IN_PROGRESS, and all 8,296 remain UNSCORED. All 8,296 measured Pfam IDs have native page routes. The measured seed worklist has no review-status field, so the statistics do not infer zero reviewed from the separate native schema. The current cross-Mech snapshot retains 16,298 evidence-lead rows from seven siblings at original acquisition pins, derived offline to the October 10 worklist. The original scan targeted 6,532 families; 1,764 additions remain marked unscanned, even where historical names resolve to current families. These leads do not validate a family's function.

notes.CMMMech: 698 canonical data/records material records: 447 mineral species, 111 secondary resources, 66 elements, 36 commodities, 31 primary resources and seven mineral groups. The 66 element records carry ChEBI identities; 284 records carry NCBITaxon organism identifiers. 500 records describe 609 mechanisms with cited evidence, assay context and limitations; 198 remain identity and characterization records without assigned mechanisms or inherited criticality. Scientific review artifacts and append-only curation history are committed. The LinkML CriticalMineralRecord schema and native strict validator exist, but there is no top-level REVIEWED-bearing status slot, so review-status statistics remain null. Counts come from the complete Git tree inventory of data/records YAML files, excluding tests and review artifacts. Record links point to pinned repository files; its website first deployed on October 12, 2026. The pin contains CC BY 4.0 project-data and BSD-3-Clause code licenses, retaining upstream terms.
notes.AIMech: The canonical inventory contains 1,929 concept records: 442 generated AIConcept records under data/aio and 1,487 maintained CuratedAIConcept records under data/curated. Imported concepts retain AIO release 2026-07-22 and its source attribution; maintained concepts carry AIMech IDs, claim-specific evidence and explicit AIO mappings or documented no-match assessments. The two schemas use NOT_REVIEWED and DRAFT respectively, with no REVIEWED-bearing status slot; scientific reviews are separate artifacts, so the common review statistic is null. Counts and source links use the complete pinned Git inventory, excluding source snapshots, reviews and history sidecars. AIMech has native LinkML schemas, validation and history support; its website first deployed on October 12, 2026. Project code is BSD-3-Clause; AIO data and derived concepts retain CC BY 4.0. Ontology membership does not demonstrate model performance, safety or mechanism. LICENSE-DATA explicitly grants CC BY 4.0 for AIO source data and derived data/aio records; that notice does not specify a data-license grant for the maintained data/curated concepts.
